The Imperative

Growth has stalled, churn is structural, and cost-to-serve keeps climbing. The industry is pouring capital into the network — yet the largest unclaimed value pool sits in the business and operating model, where autonomous agents can act end-to-end today.

We leave the network to your NEP & NOC. We transform the enterprise around it.
  • Agents reason and act across sales, marketing, service, finance, RA, fraud, roaming, wholesale, and IT — not just answer questions.
  • They connect to your OSS/BSS, CRM, billing, and partner systems through TM Forum Open APIs and MCP adapters.
  • Every high-risk action passes a human-in-the-loop gate, with full audit trails and explainability.
  • Proven ROI across 15+ departments and 20+ use cases — deployed in weeks with pre-built telco connectors.

Capability Maturity

From manual effort to an autonomous enterprise.

Most operators sit at the first two stages — copilots and point automation. Value compounds as agents move from assisting people to orchestrating whole domains. We move you up the curve deliberately, with governance at every step.

Business value and autonomy rise together — the steep gains sit in orchestration and full autonomy, where Cognirise operates.

Our Edge

Built for telcos who need outcomes, not experiments.

Ambition is easy to buy and hard to operate. Our advantage is everything that sits under the agent — trusted data, cross-domain orchestration, and enterprise governance — so results show up in production, and keep showing up.

Founded on trusted data

Unified data lakes with semantic modelling, master data management for consistent customer identities, real-time streaming from 50+ sources, and feature stores serving every agent. Agents are only as good as the data they reach — so we get that right first.

Orchestrated across domains

Agents collaborate rather than work in silos. A master agent coordinates RA, fraud, billing, and service; cross-domain root-cause analysis links network issues to complaints and disputes; automation runs from detection all the way to resolution.

Governed for enterprise scale

Human-in-the-loop gates for high-risk actions, an audit trail for every decision, compliance guardrails for GDPR, CCPA and telecom regulation, and a TM Forum-aligned architecture (ODA, Open APIs) built for interoperability.

Telco-native expertise

Deep domain knowledge of BSS, CRM, billing and customer journeys. Pre-built connectors and workflows for deployment in weeks, a scalable architecture handling millions of daily subscriber interactions, and proven ROI across 20+ use cases.

The Path Forward

From assessment to enterprise scale — fast.

A staged path that de-risks adoption: prove value on high-impact use cases first, then scale horizontally and deepen vertically.

Weeks 1–2

Assess & prioritise

AI readiness assessment, use-case prioritisation, and ROI modelling for the highest-impact, lowest-complexity wins.

Weeks 3–6

Foundation setup

Connect agents to data lakes, MDM and feature stores; establish TM Forum API connections and the governance framework.

Weeks 7–10

Pilot deployment

Deploy 2–3 agents on high-impact cases, measure KPIs against baseline, and iterate on real-world performance.

Weeks 11+

Scale & expand

Scale horizontally across departments, deepen agent capability, and introduce cross-industry innovations.
